A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
